reason: An in-session right-docked panel for reviewing cumulative file diffs made by agent edit and write operations, with user-controlled accept and rollback actions.

summaries.zh: 在会话内提供右侧差异面板，展示智能体修改或写入文件的累计 diff，并支持用户采纳或回退。
summaries.en: Provides an in-session right-side diff panel for reviewing cumulative file changes made by agent edits or writes, with user-controlled accept and rollback actions.

capabilities: Monitors observed file content changes during sessions
Displays cumulative per-file diffs in an in-session panel
Writes baseline file content back to disk when the user selects rollback
